diagnosis.diagnosis: The tool leaks the credential in the diagnostic field when debug is enabled, as shown in the evidence where the diagnostic entries contain the redacted authorization value. This violates the requirement that credentials must never appear in returned values, keys, stdout, stderr, or logging.
